fn record(hash: &mut u64, value: Option<usize>) {
    *hash = hash.rotate_left(7) ^ value.map_or(0, |n| n as u64 + 1);
}

fn main() {
    let mut bytes = [0u8; 384];
    let mut hash = 0u64;
    let mut cases = 0usize;
    for mode in 0..3 {
        for i in 0..bytes.len() {
            bytes[i] = if mode == 0 {
                (i % 7) as u8
            } else if mode == 1 {
                ((i * 37 + 11) % 256) as u8
            } else {
                b'a'
            };
        }
        for offset in 0..32 {
            for len in [
                0usize, 1, 2, 3, 7, 8, 15, 16, 17, 31, 32, 33, 63, 64, 65, 127, 128, 129, 255, 256,
            ] {
                let hay = core::hint::black_box(&bytes[offset..offset + len]);
                for needle in [0u8, 1, 6, 97, 128, 255] {
                    record(&mut hash, memchr::memchr(needle, hay));
                    record(&mut hash, memchr::memrchr(needle, hay));
                    record(&mut hash, memchr::memchr2(needle, 6, hay));
                    record(&mut hash, memchr::memrchr2(needle, 6, hay));
                    record(&mut hash, memchr::memchr3(needle, 1, 255, hay));
                    record(&mut hash, memchr::memrchr3(needle, 1, 255, hay));
                    record(&mut hash, Some(memchr::memchr_iter(needle, hay).count()));
                    for pos in memchr::memchr_iter(needle, hay) {
                        record(&mut hash, Some(pos));
                    }
                    for pos in memchr::memrchr3_iter(needle, 1, 255, hay) {
                        record(&mut hash, Some(pos));
                    }
                    cases += 1;
                }
                for n in [0usize, 1, 2, 3, 7, 16, 31, 32, 33, 64, 129] {
                    let needle = core::hint::black_box(&bytes[17..17 + n]);
                    record(&mut hash, memchr::memmem::find(hay, needle));
                    record(&mut hash, memchr::memmem::rfind(hay, needle));
                    let finder = memchr::memmem::Finder::new(needle);
                    let reverse = memchr::memmem::FinderRev::new(needle);
                    record(&mut hash, finder.clone().find(hay));
                    record(&mut hash, reverse.clone().rfind(hay));
                    for pos in memchr::memmem::find_iter(hay, needle) {
                        record(&mut hash, Some(pos));
                    }
                    for pos in memchr::memmem::rfind_iter(hay, needle) {
                        record(&mut hash, Some(pos));
                    }
                    cases += 1;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    println!("{} {}", cases, hash);
}
